description: This file defines a minimal database client module that provides an abstracted interface for CRUD operations. It supports two modes: in-memory storage using a Map and a placeholder for an external database connection. It includes a UUID v4 generator fallback for environments lacking crypto.randomUUID, and exports a factory function createDbClient that returns an async API for listing, retrieving, inserting, updating, and removing entities.

methods.name: uuid()
methods.description: Generates a UUID v4 string, using crypto.randomUUID if available, otherwise falling back to a custom implementation.

methods.name: createDbClient(config)
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a storage client object supporting list, getById, insert, update, and remove methods. The client operates either in 'memory' mode using a Map or as a placeholder for a real database.
